test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

It’s risky to invest all your savings in one company; it’s like ___________.

options.text: putting all your eggs in one basket

solution: The correct answer is **Option 2** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"putting all your eggs in one basket"** means to risk everything on the success of one venture or investment. (सभी उम्मीदें एक ही जगह पर लगाना) • **Example:** Investing all your savings in a single stock is like putting all your eggs in one basket. • **"Going down in flames"** refers to failing spectacularly or disastrously. (भयंकर रूप से असफल होना) • **Example:** The project went down in flames due to poor planning. • **"Biting the bullet"** means to endure a painful or otherwise unpleasant situation that is seen as unavoidable. (दर्दनाक स्थिति का सामना करना) • **Example:** She decided to bite the bullet and start her own business despite the risks. • **"Breaking a leg"** is a way to wish someone good luck, especially before a performance. (शुभकामनाएँ देना) • **Example:** Break a leg at your audition today! Therefore, the correct sentence is** It’s risky to invest all your savings in one company; it’s like** **putting all your eggs in one basket**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Going down in flames** (भयंकर रूप से असफल होना): Failing spectacularly or disastrously. • **Example:** The project **went down in flames** due to poor planning. • **Biting the bullet** (दर्दनाक स्थिति का सामना करना): To endure a painful or otherwise unpleasant situation that is seen as unavoidable. • **Example:** She decided to** bite the bullet** and start her own business despite the risks. • **Breaking a leg** (शुभकामनाएँ देना): A way to wish someone good luck, especially before a performance. • **Example:** **Break a leg** at your audition today! 34:Tcec, The correct answer is: **Option 2**
